utme_subjects: Literature in English or History and any other two (2) subjects
olevel_requirement: Five (5) SSC credit passes at one sitting or Six (6) SSC credit passes at two (2) sittings to include English Language, Literature in English or History, one Arts or Social Science subject and any other subject.
direct_entry: (i) Two (2) 'A' Level passes including Literature in English or History. (ii) NCE in relevant subjects.
